Commandant S.V.C.
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 3
Date 3 . 1 . 16 .

January 3rd 1916

Sir,
It is reported that a code telegram was received yesterday
at the Arsenal from the Central Government instructing General
Yang to pardon all rebels who are willing to abandon their
old ways and support the new Emperor.
The Shanghai Taoyin has sent circulars to the Magistrates
of his district announcing that from January 1st in describing
the Chinese nation, they are to use the words Tsoong Woo Ong
Hsien 中華共和 instead of Tsoong Woo Ming Koh 中華民國.
On 7th inst the yamen of the Military Governor will
be removed to Lunghwa.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen has deposited $250,000.00
in the local branch of the Bank of Taiwan, in the name of
Ban Zah Bing 孫文存.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai are in favour of
making Liang Chi Tsao 梁啓超 President as soon as Yuan Shih Kai
has been ousted.
It is reported that several members of the local Chamber
of Commerce favour the rebels and are giving them financial support.
It is reported that the Kiangsu Man Yuin Joh 江蘇滿員局
outside the South Gate will be renovated and will henceforth
be called "The Emperor's Shanghai Palace".
Residents of the City are now allowed to come and go
till 12 m.n.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：
Unless on
Ms. Jans,
Seen by Cdt?
）

阅毕后请将本案卷退还至
中央登记处

万国商团司令
上海工部局

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（刑事科）

刑事侦缉处
情报科登记
第3号
日期：16年1月3日

1916年1月3日

阁下：
据报，昨日制造局收到中央政府发来的一份密电，指示杨将军宽赦所有愿意改过自新并拥戴新皇帝的叛军。
上海道尹已向其辖区各县知事发出通告，宣布自1月1日起，在指称中国国家时，须使用“中華共和”字样以代替“中華民國”。
本月7日，护军使衙门将迁往龙华。
据报，孙中山已在台湾银行本地分行存入250,000.00元，户名为“孫文存”。
据报，上海的叛军主张在袁世凯被推翻后，立即拥立梁启超为大总统。
据报，本地总商会的数名成员偏向叛军，并正向其提供财政支持。
据报，南门外的江苏满员局将进行翻新，此后将被称为“皇帝上海行宫”。
城内居民现被允许通行至午夜12点。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

刑事侦缉总督察

警务处长

（左侧手写批注：
除非在
詹斯女士（音译），
司令已阅？
）
